title: Financial Planner
job_description:
Compensation
Location: Remote (within the US)
Compensation: $120,000–$300,000 OTE
Schedule: Full-time

About The Madison Partners
The Madison Partners is a fast-growing, tech-forward wealth management firm built for today’s investor. We combine modern planning tools, progressive marketing tactics, and a client-first service model that helps advisors spend more time with people and less time chasing tasks.

We’re expanding and looking for experienced Wealth Advisors who want to grow faster, work smarter, and build long-term client relationships with strong operational and lead-generation support.

What Makes This Role Different

A steady flow of warm leads (400/year or $400M AUM) so you can stay focused on client conversations, not cold prospecting.
Modern tools, efficient processes, and a marketing engine designed to give advisors a real edge.
W-2 stability with high earning potential and room to grow as the firm scales.

What You’ll Do

Meet with prospective and existing clients to understand goals, priorities, and financial needs.
Build tailored financial plans covering investments, retirement, tax strategy, insurance, and long-term planning.
Present clear recommendations and guide clients through decisions in a simple, understandable way.
Manage ongoing client relationships, run review meetings, and adjust plans as life and markets change.
Stay organized and compliant using our planning, CRM, and portfolio tools.
Work with our internal team for onboarding, service, and operations support.

What We’re Looking For

Experience as a Financial Advisor or Wealth Advisor (RIA experience ideal).
Active licenses required for your state.
Strong planning and communication skills.
Comfortable presenting advice to a wide range of clients and keeping relationships over time.
A growth mindset and interest in working with a firm that uses modern marketing, automation, and planning tools.
Clean compliance record.
$15+ million AUM that will follow you during a transition.

Preferred

CFP, CFA, or similar credential.

What You’ll Receive

Competitive W-2 compensation with a clear OTE path of 120–300k based on production and relationship growth.
Around 400 warm leads per year to accelerate client acquisition.
Marketing, tech, and operations support that removes friction from your day-to-day.
High-quality planning systems, CRM, and portfolio tools.
Benefits package: health, dental, vision, 401(k) options, paid time off, and professional development.
A modern culture that values speed, growth, transparency, and doing right by clients.

Who Thrives Here
Advisors who are relationship-driven, proactive, and excited about using technology to work efficiently. You enjoy connecting with clients, explaining plans clearly, and building long-term trust without needing to reinvent the prospecting wheel.

Where to Apply:

https://www.themadisonpartners.com/wealth-advisor-applicant/#advisor-application

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $120,000.00 - $300,000.00 per year

Benefits:

401(k)
401(k) matching
Dental insurance
Health insurance
Health savings account
Life insurance
Paid time off
Professional development assistance
Retirement plan

Application Question(s):

Do you have a clean U4? If not, explain why?
Are you a CFP, CFA, or have similar credentials?
Do you have a total of $15+ million AUM that would follow you during the transition? Total?

Work Location: Remote
